text: issarasuttaṃ [211] kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke kiṃsu bhaṇḍānamuttamaṃ kiṃsu satthamalaṃ 1 loke kiṃsu lokasmimabbudaṃ kiṃsu harantaṃ vārenti haranto 2 pana ko piyo kiṃsu punappunāyantaṃ abhinandanti paṇḍitāti . [212] vaso 3 issariyaṃ loke itthī bhaṇḍānamuttamaṃ kodho satthamalaṃ loke corā lokasmimabbudā coraṃ harantaṃ vārenti haranto samaṇo piyo samaṇaṃ punappunāyantaṃ abhinandanti paṇḍitāti . aṭṭhamaṃ
